name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Roundcube IMAP webmail client backed by a bundled PostgreSQL database for users, preferences, address books and sessions.

alerts.message: Roundcube is only a webmail client and needs an existing mail server. Set ROUNDCUBEMAIL_DEFAULT_HOST and ROUNDCUBEMAIL_SMTP_SERVER to your IMAP and SMTP hosts (prefix tls:// for STARTTLS or ssl:// for implicit TLS) and adjust their ports before logging in. Users sign in with their mailbox credentials.
